name: ab tuck
description: A knee raise on a vertical knee-raise station: forearms on the pads, back against the pad, knees drawn up toward the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the backrest, legs hanging.
Brace your core and keep your upper body still.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis slightly at the top.
Pause briefly, then lower your legs slowly without swinging.
